newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Rhine falls to year low on interim loss.
newsitem.headline: Rhine falls to year low on interim loss.

text.p: Shares of Rhine Holdings Ltd touched their year low late Thursday morning after the company reported an interim net loss.
"The loss triggered disappointed selling and investors are likely to continue unloading shares when they found no excuse to hold the stock," a dealing manager at a local brokerage said.
Shares of the jewellery manufacturer fell HK$0.08 or 12.12 percent to HK$0.58 in late morning.
Rhine posted an interim loss of HK$69.76 million compared with HK$8.89 million profit for the same period last year.
